name: Ecos do Inverno
source:
In a small town surrounded by snow-capped mountains, the young protagonist, Gabriel, returns after ten years away, searching for answers about the mysterious disappearance of his older sister, Helena. During his journey, he meets old friends and discovers secrets buried in the ice of the past.

[From [url=https://naborkun.itch.io/echoes-of-winter]Itch.io[/url]]
